work: Qualified old Wiegand Krynica lead as Sankostrada; created a standalone page with eight descriptions, four non-conflicting fares, two age rules, weekly hours and one exact 2025 photograph; published website and Facebook post; retained permanent backlog entry.
qualification: The named Sankostrada trough slide lies on Iwonka hill at Dąbrowskiego 15 in Krynica-Zdrój. Its own site sells per-person ride tickets and states ride rules. Krynica-Zdrój municipal tourism confirms the attraction and address. Official Park and StandaloneAttraction searches for Sankostrada and Krynica returned no matches. Góra Parkowa is a different hill and must not be merged with this ride.

sourceLimitations: The tariff table lists a group package above 20 people at PLN 140 while an older FAQ on the same site says PLN 100. The conflicting group price was deliberately not entered.
The website states daily 10:00–18:00 but warns that rain, heavy snow, fog and ice can close the track. The weekly schedule is conditional; check same-day operation.
The photograph shows the lift and sign in January 2025, rather than riders on the descent. It is exact and recent; a second licensed view of the descent would improve coverage.
